'''February 2000 Bristol tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bristol, Connecticut on 22 February 2000. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d279">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-22-bristol-connecticut-2-22-00d279/ bristol-connecticut-2-22-00], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 22 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-22-bristol-connecticut-2-22-00d279/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Bristol, Connecticut
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
